final_report: The patient has drug-induced bone marrow and pancreatic toxicities (Grade 3 neutropenia, Grade 4 lipase elevation) without progression to sepsis, acute pancreatitis, or multi-organ failure. Superior vena cava syndrome resolved early, and ECOG 1 indicates preserved functional status. The absence of acute airway compromise, hemodynamic instability, or rapid deterioration supports a low short-term mortality risk.
